scenario: An online kids-media and in-app-purchase platform conducts a COPPA compliance audit. The pipeline ingests and normalizes the platform's user data-collection inventory (account creation records, in-app-purchase history, device-location logs) and consent records, evaluates each data flow against 16 CFR Part 312 requirements, and produces a compliance-audit report for internal counsel and FTC submission readiness review.
info_flow: crm-data-cleaner normalizes the user account and consent records, producing a cleaned inventory with audience-classification and PII-type fields → presale-regulation-auditor evaluates each normalized data flow against COPPA 16 CFR Part 312 rules, producing a staleness/compliance matrix → reporting assembles the matrix into a formal compliance-audit report.
